page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: iuxta exemplū Elcanæ, 1.Reg.1.) vel fœcun-ditatem, quasi nescientes, quòd à naturæ Có-ditore fiant universa: & quòd neq; coitus, ne-que aliud quiddam ad procreandos pueros sufficere potest, nisi cooperetur manus su-perna, quæ naturam ad procreandum exci-tet. Quæ fanè iustus ille sciens, uxori non imputabat quòd carebant filijs, sed congru-uum honorem semper ei tribuebat. Item in Abrahamo laudabilis est fides in expectan-da promissione per decè annos in Chanaan: præterea eius mansuetudo erga irritatam v-vore[?], & studiû conservandæ pacis in domo.

In Agar notanda superbia, & servilis inge-nij natura, quæ res prosperas moderatè ferre nequit, & ingratitudo, & impatientia: quæ vitia angelus Domini in ea reprehendit, & contrà humilitatem docuit, atq; animi sub-missionem. In hoc tamen commendanda est hæc ancilla, quòd angelo interroganti, unde veniret, respondit: A facie Sarae dominę meę ego fugio. Citra odium enim meminit dominæ:neq; dicit, Malè me afflixit, gravia mihi fecit, verbis, minis, impositis servilibus operi-bus, nec possum ferre molestiam eius, & ideò fugam inij: nihil asperum loquuta est: sed so-lum seipsam, ut fugitivam accusavit.

Postremò hic etiam apparet afflictionis fructus, & invocationis nominis Domini ef-fectus. Bonus enim est Dominus sine respe-ctu personarum omnib.invocantib.se. Huic debetur honos, imperium, & potestas in æ-ternum, Amen.

page.notes: Printed page with no marginal notes. Long s was read as s throughout. "v-vore" at the line end of the first paragraph: the word after the hyphen is read as "vore" and may be "uxore"; marked [?]. Small mark below the last line (near the centre bottom) is a possible gathering or printer's mark, not transcribed. Some marks at the left margin and top left are stains or scan dirt. Printed spellings such as "Sarae", "dominę", "meę", "dominæ" and "næ:neq;" are kept as printed.
